tool-call.label: Tool call: {{name}}

grant-source.delegated-hint: The agent used the rights of the person who started it.
grant-source.agent-hint: The agent used a right it was granted itself, beyond the rights of the people involved.

approval.title: Approval required
approval.fallback-summary: Review this action before it runs.
approval.waiting-for: Waiting for {{name}} to decide. The action uses their permissions.
approval.waiting-for-participant: Waiting for the participant who started this task to decide.
approval.waiting-for-approver: Waiting for an approver to decide.

proposal-feedback.bulk: Applies to the {{count}} proposals you rejected.

hints.wrong-value: The right action, with the wrong values.
hints.not-now: Right, but not at this moment.

result-codes.api-bridge-forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
result-codes.api-bridge-conflict: The item was changed in the meantime.
result-codes.assistant-proposal-recorded: Proposed; waits for a person's approval
result-codes.assistant-proposal-rejected: Not run: the proposal was rejected.
result-codes.assistant-proposal-expired: Not run: nobody decided before the proposal expired.
result-codes.assistant-proposal-withdrawn: Not run: the proposal was withdrawn.

result-codes.assistant-proposal-execution-failed: The approved proposal could not be run.

result-codes.assistant-proposal-recently-rejected: Not proposed again: people rejected it recently.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.assistant-network: The assistant cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.assistant-unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to use the assistant.
errors.assistant-forbidden: You do not have access to the assistant.
errors.assistant-not-found: The item no longer exists. Reload and try again.
errors.assistant-conversation-busy: The assistant is still busy with this conversation. Try again in a moment.
errors.assistant-invalid-response: The assistant sent an unexpected response.
errors.assistant-stream-interrupted: The connection to the assistant was interrupted.
errors.assistant-server: The assistant could not complete the request.
errors.assistant-validation: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.assistant-version-conflict: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload and apply your change again.
errors.assistant-mcp-unreachable: The MCP server cannot be reached.
errors.assistant-mcp-unauthorized: The MCP server rejected the credentials.
errors.assistant-mcp-host-blocked: This host is not allowed for MCP servers or for forwarding the user's token.
errors.assistant-mcp-schema-changed: The tool's input changed on the server. Review it and enable it again.
errors.assistant-instructions-too-long: The text is too long. Shorten it to at most 20,000 characters.
errors.assistant-context-not-found: The application context was not found. Reload the page.
errors.assistant-mcp-server-not-found: The MCP server no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.assistant-mcp-tool-not-found: The MCP tool no longer exists. Sync the server and try again.
errors.assistant-agent-exists: An agent with this id already exists. Choose another id.
errors.assistant-mcp-server-exists: An MCP server with this id already exists. Choose another id.
errors.assistant-code-agent-not-deletable: Agents from the application code cannot be deleted. Disable the agent instead.
errors.assistant-agent-not-code: Only agents from the application code can be reset.
errors.assistant-actor-mismatch: This action belongs to another user's session. Reload the page and try again.
errors.assistant-agent-forbidden: You do not have access to this agent. Choose another agent.
errors.assistant-agent-not-found: This agent is no longer available. Choose another agent.
errors.assistant-approval-decision-invalid: The decision could not be processed. Approve or reject the action again.
errors.assistant-approval-expired: The approval has expired, so nothing was changed. Ask the assistant again.
errors.assistant-approval-invalid: The approval no longer matches the proposed change, so nothing was changed. Ask the assistant again.
errors.assistant-approval-not-found: This approval no longer exists. Reload the conversation.
errors.assistant-approval-not-pending: This approval was already decided. Reload the conversation.
errors.assistant-approval-rejected: You rejected this action, so nothing was changed.
errors.assistant-budget-exhausted: You have reached today's assistant limit. You can use the assistant again tomorrow.
errors.assistant-context-unavailable: Your session could not be identified. Sign in again and retry.
errors.assistant-conversation-not-found: This conversation no longer exists. Start a new conversation.
errors.assistant-message-duplicate: This message was already sent. Wait for the answer.
errors.assistant-message-invalid: The message is empty or not valid. Write a question and send it again.
errors.assistant-message-too-long: The message is too long. Shorten it and send it again.
errors.assistant-model-unavailable: The language model is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.assistant-proposal-hash-mismatch: The proposed change was modified in the meantime, so nothing was changed. Reload the conversation and decide again.
errors.assistant-title-invalid: The conversation title is not valid. Use a shorter title.
errors.assistant-tool-call-limit-reached: The assistant reached the maximum number of steps for one answer. Ask a narrower question.
errors.assistant-tools-disabled: No further actions were run in this answer because an action was rejected.
errors.assistant-turn-failed: The assistant could not finish the answer. Try again.
errors.assistant-turn-timeout: The answer took too long and was stopped. Try again or ask a narrower question.
errors.assistant-owner-required: Only the owner of this conversation can do this.
errors.assistant-approval-forbidden: Only the person who started this task can decide about it.
errors.assistant-turn-forbidden: Only the owner or the person who started this task can stop it.
errors.assistant-share-link-invalid: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask the owner for a new one.
errors.assistant-participant-not-found: This person is not part of the conversation.
errors.assistant-participant-limit-reached: This conversation has the maximum number of participants.
errors.assistant-directory-unavailable: Inviting colleagues directly is not available.
errors.assistant-push-subscription-invalid: This browser could not be registered for notifications.
errors.assistant-conversation-removed: This conversation is no longer available to you.
errors.assistant-subject-type-unknown: This kind of subject is not known to the assistant.
errors.assistant-subject-access-denied: Your role on this subject does not allow this.
errors.assistant-no-accountable-owner: Nobody answers for this agent on this subject.
errors.assistant-agent-configured-off: This agent is disabled in the application's configuration.
errors.assistant-agent-paused: This agent is paused; the request waits until it resumes.
errors.assistant-run-token-limit: This run stopped because it reached its token budget. What it did so far stays; an approver can resume it.
errors.assistant-skill-stopped: This skill of the agent has been stopped.
errors.assistant-skill-paused: This skill of the agent is paused; its events wait until it resumes.
errors.assistant-skill-not-found: The agent has no such skill.
errors.assistant-skill-not-available: That skill is not available now.
errors.assistant-skill-switch-limit: The run already switched skills as often as allowed.
errors.assistant-handoff-unavailable: Only an agent run can hand work to another agent.
errors.assistant-handoff-not-accepted: That agent does not accept this work from this agent.
errors.assistant-handoff-subject-unavailable: The subject does not exist or belongs to another organisation.
errors.assistant-handoff-shadow-to-live: An agent in shadow mode cannot hand work to an agent that works for real.
errors.assistant-handoff-chain-limit: The chain of hand-offs is as long as allowed or would return to an agent in it.
errors.assistant-handoff-limit-reached: This agent handed this subject to that agent as often as allowed today.

errors.assistant-evaluation-not-variant: That agent is not a shadow variant to compare with.
errors.assistant-agent-not-configured: This agent cannot run on its own.
errors.assistant-approval-policy-denied: You may not decide this proposal.
errors.assistant-four-eyes-required: Someone other than the person who started this must decide it.
errors.assistant-execution-not-uncertain: This execution is not waiting to be resolved.
errors.assistant-proposal-stale: This proposal no longer applies, for example because the work was already done. Nothing was changed.
errors.assistant-proposal-check-failed: Whether this proposal still applies could not be checked, so nothing was changed. Try again later.
errors.assistant-proposal-already-open: The same proposal already waits for a decision.
errors.assistant-proposal-recently-rejected: People rejected the same proposal recently.
errors.assistant-proposal-superseded: A newer proposal replaced this one.
errors.assistant-proposal-refused: This action cannot be proposed by an automatic rule.
errors.assistant-webhook-signature-invalid: The webhook call has no valid signature.

errors.assistant-feedback-invalid: Choose one of the listed reasons and keep the explanation under 1,000 characters.
errors.assistant-feedback-not-accepted: Feedback is possible only after a proposal was rejected or closed.
errors.assistant-consult-subject-unavailable: The subject does not exist or you may not consult the agent about it.
errors.assistant-consult-agent-unavailable: The agent cannot be consulted right now.
errors.assistant-consult-depth-exceeded: This consultation would ask agents in a loop or nest too deeply.
errors.assistant-consult-budget-exhausted: The agent's daily budget is spent.
errors.assistant-consult-limit-reached: You reached the daily number of consultations.
errors.assistant-consult-timeout: The agent did not answer in time.
errors.assistant-moved-to-shadow: The work went to the agent's shadow thread, where a run in shadow takes it.
errors.assistant-shadow-variant: A shadow variant always works in shadow.

notices.no-answer: The assistant finished without an answer. Try again or rephrase your question.
notices.conversation-removed: This conversation is no longer available to you.

preferences.title: Your preferences
preferences.description: Choose how the assistant answers you. Preferences change the style only; they never change what the assistant may do or which actions need your approval.

style.direct-description: Short, factual answers without small talk.
style.detailed-description: Thorough answers with background and explanation.

preferences.custom-instructions-hint: Optional. For example: answer with bullet points. Your instructions never override the assistant's rules.
preferences.load-failed: Your preferences could not be loaded.

notifications-state.on: You get a notification when a longer task finishes or needs your approval while you are away.
notifications-state.prompt: Your browser asks for permission the next time you send a message.
notifications-state.blocked: Your browser blocks notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser settings.
notifications-state.off: Notifications are off for all your devices.

admin.title: Assistant administration
admin.description: Manage the application context, the agents and the MCP servers of the assistant. Changes apply from the next turn.
admin.load-failed: The data could not be loaded.
admin.forbidden-description: You need the assistant administration permission to open this page.
admin.invalid-id: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.

context.title: Application context
context.description: Background about the application that every agent receives before its own instructions. It cannot override the assistant's fixed rules. Do not include personal data or secrets.
context.label: Context text
context.conflict: Someone saved a newer version. Your text is kept; load the latest version, compare and save again.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Code agents come from the application; you can override or reset them. Agents you create here can be deleted. Pause, stop and resume any agent; its definition stays as it is.
agents.reset-keeps-state: Resetting restores the code definition; the agent stays active, paused or stopped as it is.

state.configured-off-hint: Disabled in the application's code until the next deployment; it cannot be resumed here.

explain.active: The agent works again. Every subject with waiting events gets one run.
explain.paused: No new runs start. Events wait and run after the resume; running work finishes and approved proposals execute.
explain.stopped: Active runs are cancelled, their open proposals withdrawn and waiting events dropped. Approved proposals wait until the agent works again.

skills.title: Skills
skills.budget: Budget per day: {{calls}} tool calls, {{tokens}} tokens

explain.active: The skill {{skill}} works again. Every subject with events waiting for it gets one run.
explain.paused: The skill {{skill}} starts no new runs: its events wait, triage no longer chooses it and running work finishes. The other skills keep working.
explain.stopped: The runs of the skill {{skill}} are cancelled and its waiting events dropped; its triggers are refused. The other skills keep working.

shadow.hint: Its work goes to shadow threads that only administrators see.
shadow.locked: A shadow variant always works in shadow.

explain.shadow: New runs work in shadow threads that only administrators see: nobody is notified and nothing proposed there executes. Running work finishes as it started; the live threads and their open proposals stay.
explain.live: New runs work live: people see them, are notified and decide their proposals.
explain.code: The mode in code decides again.

skill-explain.shadow: Work that reaches the skill {{skill}} goes to the shadow threads; the other skills keep their mode.
skill-explain.live: The skill {{skill}} works live again, unless its agent works in shadow.
skill-explain.code: The mode in code decides again for the skill {{skill}}.

explain.set: New runs answer to this account and use its rights. Runs that started and their proposals keep their account.
explain.code: New runs answer to the account in code again: {{account}}.

agent-editor.id-hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. The id cannot change later.
agent-editor.instructions-hint: What the agent does and how it answers.
agent-editor.autonomy-hint: Only Execute allows changes, and every change still needs approval.
agent-editor.required-policy-hint: Optional. Only users who pass this policy see the agent.
agent-editor.state-hint: Pause, stop and resume the agent from the agent list. Saving never changes its state.
agent-editor.tool-selectors-hint: Choose tools from the catalog or add a pattern such as sample-api.project.*. MCP tools come from the assigned servers.
agent-editor.no-selectors: No tool selectors. The agent can only answer from its instructions and assigned MCP servers.
agent-editor.mcp-servers-hint: Enabled tools of these servers become available to this agent.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connect remote MCP servers. Their tools start disabled and are treated as changes that need approval until you mark them read-only.

server-editor.id-hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, at most 40 characters. The id cannot change later.
server-editor.url-hint: https is required; http is only allowed for localhost during development.
server-editor.secret-hint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
server-editor.secret-will-clear: The secret will be cleared when you save.
server-editor.forward-warning: The signed-in user's token is sent to this server. The server's host must be on the allow-list of the application.
server-editor.required-policy-hint: Optional. The server's tools are only available to users who pass this policy.

tools.title: Tools of {{name}}
tools.description: Tools stay disabled and are treated as changes that need approval until you enable them and choose the effect. Annotations from the server are hints only.
tools.empty: No tools yet. Sync the server to load its tools.
tools.schema-changed-warning: The tool's input changed on the server, so the tool was disabled. Review the tool before you enable it again.
tools.missing-warning: The server no longer lists this tool.

feedback.title: Feedback on proposals
feedback.description: What people said when they rejected this agent's proposals. Compare agent versions to see whether a change to the prompt, tools or policy helped.
feedback.export-hint: The export holds subject data and the proposed tool input, and is recorded in the audit log.
feedback.category-hint: The category narrows the feedback and the export.
feedback.summary-empty: The agent made no proposals in this period.
feedback.invalidated-hint: Open proposals that closed before anyone decided, because the work was already done or no longer applied. They do not count as rejected.
feedback.list-empty: Nobody gave feedback in this period.
feedback.author: By {{actor}}
feedback.bulk-hint: Given once for several proposals rejected together; weigh it lower.

evaluation.title: Evaluation of shadow variants
evaluation.description: Compares a shadow variant with the live agent: the runs that handled the same events, the proposals both made or only one made, what people decided about the live ones, and what each cost.
evaluation.export-hint: The export holds identifiers, statuses, usage and proposal identities, no messages or arguments. It is audited.
evaluation.small-numbers: Small numbers mislead: read the counts next to every share.
evaluation.replayed-hint: Replayed runs saw today's state of each subject; a subject that changed since can explain a difference.
evaluation.truncated: The period holds more runs than one evaluation reads; it covers the oldest ones.
evaluation.tools-empty: The paired runs made no proposals.
evaluation.replay-hint: Fires the live agent's recorded runs of the period into the variant, oldest first, against today's state of each subject; at most {{max}} runs. The variant's budget and limits apply.
evaluation.replay-progress: {{replayed}} of at most {{max}} runs replayed, {{skipped}} skipped

page-context.exclude: Do not send {{page}} with this message

share.title: Share conversation
share.description: People you share with read the whole conversation, including tool results, and can continue it with their own permissions.
share.link-hint: Anyone in your organization who may use this assistant can join with the link. A new link replaces the old one; people who joined stay.
share.not-shared: Only you take part in this conversation.
share.no-conversation: Start or open a conversation to share it.

thread.title: Agent
thread.waiting-inputs: {{count}} messages wait for the next run
thread.no-proposals: The agent has proposed nothing here yet.
thread.no-thread: The agent has not worked on this yet.

outcome.queued: The agent starts after the current run.
outcome.coalesced: Your request joins the run that is about to start.
outcome.superseded: The current run stops and the agent starts again.
outcome.ignored: The agent is busy; nothing was started.
outcome.rejected: The agent could not be started.

thread.shadow: Shadow thread: only administrators see it, and nothing proposed here executes.

subject.title: Agent suggestions
subject.description: Proposals that agents made here and that wait for a decision, the first to expire on top.
subject.unavailable: You cannot see agent work on this item.

inbox.title: Proposals to decide
inbox.description: Proposals of agents that wait for your decision, the ones that expire first on top.

proposal.unknown-hint: The execution stopped without a known outcome. Check whether it happened before you run it again.
proposal.from-consultation-hint: Another assistant consulted the agent for this person; it runs with that person's rights only.

skill-chosen-by.follow-up: as the follow-up of a decision

memory.not-configured: This agent keeps no working memory.
memory.empty: The agent has not noted anything yet.

artifacts.download-failed: The file could not be downloaded.

consultation.empty: No assistant has consulted this agent about this subject yet.
consultation.private: Only who asked and how it ended is shown here; the question and the answer stay in the asking conversation.
